$comment: Machine-readable data-source licence records ($data-licence's contract). DATA_SOURCES.md is what a human reads; this is what $layer-steward and $knowledge-steward check programmatically. The two must never disagree — if they do, this manifest is wrong until proven otherwise. unknown commercialUse is BLOCKING, never permission.

sources.name: TeleGeography Submarine Cable Map
sources.remedy: Delete the folder or license from TeleGeography before any commercial build; self-contained, app runs without it. Registered layer: telegeography-submarine-cables.

sources.name: Bhote Koshi event pack (Vantor imagery crops, GeoPera-derived river centerline)
sources.remedy: Arrived with the September 2026 upstream Nepal merge. Deleting only public/events/bhote-koshi-2026/ is NOT sufficient — src/data/bhoteKoshiFloodPath.js is derived from the same NC source and compiles into the scene; excluding it also requires removing the scene's registrations and imports before building. Registered layers: bhote-koshi-2026, bhote-koshi-locator.

sources.name: Datacenters (~4.3K)
sources.remedy: Commercial use fine; share-alike attaches to a publicly distributed modified database — keep derived DBs separate from MIT code and offer modifications under ODbL.
